searchLog: Read profile.md, target-companies.json, sent-log.json (last ~40 'opportunities' entries through 2026-09-16 -- Palantir FDE, 3x Anthropic Fellows, NVIDIA, Kyber FDE, mostly Google-News-RSS fallback titles), applications.json (empty), and life/PIPELINE.md for exclusions (Notion, Stripe PM, Disney APM, Tuck Bridge, IBM x6, Claude Corps, Ford FCG, Red Ventures, TikTok, Goldman Sachs, CIL, MIT Future Fest, MLH, Horizon, 3x Adobe, Micron, Kalshi, MATS, Anthropic Fellows July cohort, Northslope, Last Mile, Yale SOM). Checked the graduation-date conflict flagged in this run's own instructions: life/PROFILE.md shows December 2026 was SETTLED by Dom on 2026-08-04 and both hub files now agree on December 2026 -- there is no live conflict; the 'Aug-Dec 2026 unsettled' framing in this run's instructions is itself stale (this is at least the second consecutive run to catch this). Before spending search/fetch budget, re-verified the WebFetch/egress path directly against 5 job-board hosts (anthropic.com, greenhouse.io, ashbyhq.com x2, stripe.com): all returned EGRESS_BLOCKED / CONNECT 403, explicitly 'organization policy' per the proxy's own status output, identical to every hunt run since ~2026-08-18 -- this is now the sixth consecutive week. WebSearch still works and surfaced plausible-looking candidates, but hunt.md's honesty rules forbid including anything not confirmed by actually fetching the live page, which remains impossible in this environment. No candidate could be verified, so none is included. Zero verified opportunities is the correct, honest output for a sixth consecutive week -- this is an unresolved environment/org-level network-egress-policy gap (careers/job-board domains not allowlisted for this session's proxy), not a shortage of findable roles, and needs a human to fix the egress policy; no amount of additional search or retry budget changes this outcome.
